averygan/reclip.caption:
🚨 PASTE A LINK. GET THE VIDEO. NO ADS.

Reclip is a self-hosted media downloader with a clean web UI. 9.7k stars. MIT.

Ships with:
• Videos and audio from 1,000+ sites via yt-dlp
• YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X, Reddit, and more
• MP4 or MP3, with a quality picker
• Bulk paste, auto-deduped URLs
•
